**Which game**
<!-- The Return of the King (PC), The Return of the King (Xbox) or The Two Towers (Xbox) -->

**Athelas version**
<!-- For example 1.0 (the launcher's About tab) -->

**What happened**
<!-- What you saw, and what you did just before. Screenshots help. -->

**Your PC**
<!-- Windows version, graphics card, controller if you use one -->

**The log** (drag the file into this box)
- The Return of the King (PC): `ROTKFix.log` in the game folder
- The Return of the King (Xbox): `ROTK-Xbox\rotkx.log` beside the launcher
- The Two Towers: `TT-Xbox\tt.log` beside the launcher

After an Xbox port crashes, also attach the newest `.dmp` file from its `CrashDumps` folder. Zip it first
(right-click > Compress to ZIP file), as GitHub doesn't take `.dmp` files as they are.

The logs include your settings and the folders your games are in, which can show your Windows user name.
